text: Periodically rise up to see the whole map. Regularly find moments to step away from current “super-important” tasks and look at your life or project from a bird’s-eye view. Ask yourself questions: “Where is my path leading? How important and effective is the action being performed at the current moment on the scale of the overall scheme? What new trends are appearing?”. In this way you develop ajna, and also prevent movement by inertia, correcting your course in time.
